title: PortalBlockList v1 (the bundle's _blocks.json)
description: Validates the `<stem>_blocks.json` member of a portal bundle (W55-PLAN.md sections B3.1 and B3.5). It is the portal's file, so unknown properties are tolerated at every level: the portal may add some, and refusing them would refuse a good bundle. What this product reads is required. Rules a JSON Schema cannot state are code rules of the ingest envelope and are listed in `x-envelope-rules`. `document_id`, `document_name`, `document_path` and every `crop_url` are the portal's: `document_id` collides with this product's `doc_` prefix and is ignored, and a `crop_url` is a capability URL that is never fetched, stored for display or rendered.

status.description: The portal's status. Observed: `recognized` and `failed`. A `failed` block is tolerated and shown as such.

polygon_points.description: The polygon's [x, y] vertices in the same normalised space, or null for a rectangle. Observed: 6 to 11 vertices.

x-envelope-rules: pages[].page_index runs 0..n-1 without a gap or a repeat, and n equals the PDF's page count.
blocks[].block_id is unique in the file; every blocks[].page_index names a page.
coords_norm is [x0, y0, x1, y1] with x0 < x1 and y0 < y1.
ordinal is not unique (the portal numbers per page, and a stamp has none); order is by page, ordinal and block_id.
Every TEXT and IMAGE block has exactly one header in the recognised-text markdown, with the same type, and the markdown has no header for a block the list does not hold; a STAMP block has none.
